verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly claim GPU acceleration for Apple Metal, NVIDIA, AMD, and Vulkan (llamafile-docs-12), which would satisfy the story. However hands-on community reports contradict this working smoothly: one user's GPU is barely used despite having 8GB VRAM and asks how to get GPU offload working, another reports CUDA compilation errors causing fallback to CPU, and another notes GPU acceleration requires installing separate CUDA/dev toolkits on the end machine, undermining the 'single-file, works everywhere' vendor promise. Missing for 10: independent benchmark confirming AMD/Vulkan acceleration actually engages GPU out-of-the-box, and resolution of the reported CUDA build failures.
